data: How many different entrainment profile categories are represented in the figure?

The figure contains two subfigures, each representing a different entrainment measure. The left subfigure represents the entrainment profile for proximity, while the right subfigure represents the entrainment profile for synchrony. Each subfigure contains six lines, which represent six different entrainment categories. Therefore, there are six different entrainment profile categories represented in the figure.
